label: Majority Standard Bible
textualBasis: OT translated from the Masoretic Text. NT translated from the Byzantine Majority Text, representing the manuscript tradition preserved in the majority of surviving Greek NT manuscripts. Combines the Berean Standard Bible base with NT revisions to reflect the Majority Text tradition.
